title: Relational Bottleneck Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.32227v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Achieving both interpretable and high-performance inference is a key challenge in deep learning. While Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) provide inherent interpretability, they are constrained by task-specific training and rely on isolated visual concepts that fail to capture higher-order visual semantic relationships. Conversely, Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate zero-shot capabilities through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, standard CoT lacks a strict causal dependency between the generated rationale and the final output, compromising faithfulness. To bridge this gap, we propose Relational Bottleneck Models (RBMs), a novel training-free framework that transforms any off-the-shelf LVLMs into inherently interpretable models in a plug-and-play manner. translated_abstract: 实现既可解释又高性能的推理是深度学习中的一个关键挑战。概念瓶颈模型（CBMs）虽然提供了内在的可解释性，但受限于任务特定的训练，且依赖于孤立的视觉概念，无法捕捉高阶的视觉语义关系。相反，大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）通过思维链（CoT）推理展现了零样本能力。然而，标准的CoT在生成的推理依据与最终输出之间缺乏严格的因果依赖关系，损害了推理的忠实性。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了关系瓶颈模型（RBMs），这是一种新颖的免训练框架，能够以即插即用的方式将任何现成的LVLM转化为内在可解释的模型。RBMs包含两个阶段：（i）结构化推理依据生成（SRG），显式地将视觉概念之间的语义交互建模为主-谓-宾（三元组）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了免训练、即插即用的关系瓶颈模型（RBMs），通过结构化推理依据生成显式建模视觉概念间的语义关系，将现成的大型视觉语言模型转化为兼具可解释性与高性能的内在可解释模型。
en_tdlr: Proposes Relational Bottleneck Models (RBMs), a training-free, plug-and-play framework that transforms off-the-shelf large vision-language models into inherently interpretable models by explicitly modeling semantic interactions between visual concepts through structured rationale generation.
